description: On-device tcc stress (bigger program): the Dunit tcc compiles+links /assets/tcc/stress.c — multiple functions, recursion (fib), qsort+malloc/free+calloc, structs, snprintf/strcmp, a prime sieve — into /tmp/stress, which the kernel runs. A larger translation unit exercises more of tcc's codegen and more of libc, and stresses tcc's own heap. Fixed inputs -> fixed results (25 primes <100, fib20=6765). Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_tcc_stress_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 60 --timeout 320 --boot-timeout 180

required.claim: tcc compiled+linked a larger multi-function program on-device and it ran with correct results (sieve/fib/qsort/struct/string)

forbidden.why: tcc failed to compile/link the bigger program (codegen or heap limit?)
the compiled program produced wrong results
